facts.business: Khazanchi Jewellers Limited is an Indian jewellery enterprise engaged in the design, manufacturing, and retail of gold and diamond jewellery, operating through an asset-light model with in-house design capabilities and manufacturing partners.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Targeting ₹500 Cr in retail sales much earlier than the expected timeline
Intend to open new showrooms, expand the Vajraa Diamonds range, and shift further toward higher-margin products
guidance_or_targets.value: New showrooms and expanded Vajraa Diamonds range

guidance_or_targets.statement: Formulating a dedicated silver jewellery strategy to establish a strong presence in the fast-growing segment
Plan to launch dedicated platforms for B2B trade and B2C e-commerce
guidance_or_targets.value: B2B trade and B2C e-commerce platforms

key_risks: Government efforts to curb gold imports
Increasing availability of alternative jewellery options
